description: Find pintxos bars, restaurants, cafes and wineries that Gozatu! has visited and reviewed in Donostia-San Sebastián and the Basque Country. Filter by name or keyword, district, type, opening time ("now" or a date and time) and distance to a point. Each place has its review URL, type, district, coordinates, opening hours for the requested day and whether it is open at that time; restaurant holidays are taken into account. Opening hours come from the author's reviews, not from the venues in real time.

district.description: Optional district of San Sebastián, e.g. "Parte Vieja", "Gros", "Centro", "Antiguo", "Egia", "Amara".

near_lat.description: Optional latitude of a point; results are sorted by distance.

open_at.description: Optional: "now" or a local date and time such as "2026-12-19T20:30" (Europe/Madrid). Only places open at that time are returned.

radius_m.description: Optional radius in metres around the point (default 1000, maximum 50000).

type.description: Optional type: bar (pintxos bar), restaurant, cafe, weingut (winery), other (sights and others).

name: find_places
title: Find bars, restaurants and cafes
